pick.eligible: profiles whose source fired; every profile when no source is given

provider_assignment: reviewer i takes providers[i mod len(providers)]; a requested provider absent from the available set is status unavailable, never substituted

reviewer_status.error: every reviewer whose status is neither ok nor skipped carries a non-empty error naming why: the recorded error text (the result's `error`, else the planned reviewer's `error`) when it is a non-empty string, else the reason of the precedence rule that decided the status ({error_kind} replaced by the recorded kind). An ok reviewer never carries one; a skipped one carries none from the merge. The text is copied, never a key.

planned_final.unavailable: the requested provider is not available here
planned_final.unsupported: the run mode cannot execute this reviewer's call mode

reasons.error_kind: the call failed with kind {error_kind} and recorded no error text
reasons.placeholder_reply: the reply was only a no-findings placeholder
reasons.otherwise: the reply held no findings array

id.normalize: each field stripped and its whitespace runs collapsed to one space; joined by a newline
id.means: a finding is the same finding in every round and every reviewer while its rule, file and anchor line are: ids never carry a line number or a date

escalate.severity: the most severe any reviewer of the group gave, by severity_order
escalate.security: true when any reviewer of the group said true

rules.principles: the family principles {id, name, statement}, given by the caller at load (--principles FILE; never imported, never copied here)
rules.registry: the family rule registry's ids, given by the caller at load (--rules; never imported, never copied here)
rules.fills: the finding schema property finding_field gets enum = every given principle id then every registry id, at load; no file lists them
rules.prompt_schema_means: filled: the prompt finding schema carries the ids enum; unfilled: it does not, since the rules partial already lists every id. Validation always uses the filled schema
